differences.what: the north party wall's lights: east of the parging, narrow single stair lights at their own heights in two columns (s 2.05: ground and second floor; s 5.2-5.44: one a storey) and a tall light in the top storey of the part behind the front block, none on the rear block
differences.how: T-3626: laid as side_bays read off this camera, and rear_3b's top storey; the draft had a ground-to-top column on each rear part and none on the main body

differences.what: no stack on the north parapet, front to rear
differences.how: T-3626: the draft's two reconstructed stacks stood on the north wall; moved to the south party wall, where the nomination puts the fireplaces

differences.what: the parapet line: unbroken at about 14.2-15 m from the front back to the rear block's terrace (u -3.8)
differences.how: T-3626: rear_3b's top storey raised from 4.0 to the front block's 4.6 m; the draft stepped down 0.6 m behind the front block

differences.what: the rear block: its north wall up to about 11.4 m at the east end and an open, roofed porch on its top floor to about 14 m (u -8.8 to -4.1), where the build stands two storeys to 8.95 m with a flat deck
differences.how: the nomination's 'top floor of the rear section is open to provide a terrace'; K01's wings have no open, roofed porch on a deck to build it with

differences.what: a small high light in the ground storey behind the front block (s 2.24 on rear_3b, about 0.5 x 0.64 m, sill 4.9 m)
differences.how: under the bar a street visitor would notice, and below a K01 wing sash's 1.5 m least height; not built

differences.what: the wall's face: parged common brick over the west half where 2011 stood, bare common brick east of it
differences.how: the parging is post-1955 (2011 demolished); in 1904 the west half stood against 2011 and the east half is the common brick the record lays. The print is monochrome

differences.what: the front's balustrade, gone in 2003, finials on its end pedestals
differences.how: a later loss, argued from the 1895 plate, which draws the balustrade whole (the nomination: the pedestals 'originally framing the balustrade')

differences.what: 2011 and 2009 beside it, the fence, the cars, the 2003 skyline
differences.how: 2003 surroundings; 2011 is rendered in the 1904 scene from its own record and left out of this view, which is about 2013's north wall

_how: verdict is unreviewed | differs | matches, set by whoever compared the side-by-side with the picture; each difference is {what, status: open | fixed | not shown | within tolerance | owner ruling} — open only if a street visitor would notice it (over about 1 ft, missing, mis-shaped, miscounted, wrong material or colour), else within tolerance (T-3153); owner ruling where the owner asked the build to depart from the picture (T-3236).
